comparison.objective: Snap a sip lid completely around the rim of a full paper cup.
comparison.physical_skill: Circumferential sequential latching with restrained pressing that avoids tipping or crushing the cup.
comparison.success_condition: All eight lid sectors seated; cup remains undamaged and near its start; hands released and objects stable for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Distributed rim snapping and thin-container damage avoidance are materially different from parallel rail/jig mating and ball-preserving linear transfer.
